description: Check whether an IBAN is well formed: country length (SWIFT IBAN registry) and ISO 13616 check digits. For Spanish IBANs also the two account check digits (DC) and the bank (entidad) with its BIC from the Banco de España registry. A 20-digit Spanish account number (CCC) is converted to its IBAN. Pure arithmetic: it does NOT confirm that the account exists or who owns it.

iban.description: IBAN or 20-digit Spanish account, spaces allowed

name: validate_iban
title: Validate an IBAN
